entities.name: Kamitaki
entities.description: The center for blue mana on Kamigawa; "waterfall of the kami", the plane's highest and widest falls.

entities.name: Yumegawa River
entities.description: The longest flow of water on the plane; runs over the gorge forming the falls.

entities.name: Lake Kamitaki
entities.description: Turbulent pool below the falls that feeds the Akagi River.

entities.name: Akagi River
entities.description: River near the falls where a famous battle between humans and kami took place.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: The wizard academy for humans, built on the falls.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: A Soratami city resting on clouds above the lake.

entities.name: Oboro Palace
entities.description: The cloud palace of the Soratami.

entities.name: Towabara Plains
entities.description: Plains crossed by the Akagi River.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: Forest into which the Akagi River runs.

events.summary: A famous battle between humans and kami takes place near the falls on the Akagi River.
